map.民间借贷利率受司法保护上限约束，约定年利率超过合同成立时一年期贷款市场报价利率（: Private lending rates are capped by judicial protection: a court will not support the part of an agreed annual rate exceeding four times the one-year Loan Prime Rate (LPR) at contract formation.
